name: Pimoroni Inky Frame 7.3" (Spectra 6)
description: 7.3 inch 800x480 Inky Frame (Pico 2 W aboard) with the Spectra 6 E673 panel shipped from September 2025. Driven by the tesserae-device-inkyframe Pico SDK firmware (the inkyframe2_spectra build) over the REST device API, with setup from a phone, button letters and signed over-the-air updates. Owners of the earlier 7-colour ACeP revision should use pimoroni_inky_frame_73_acep.
notes_md: Firmware: [dmellok/tesserae-device-inkyframe](https://github.com/dmellok/tesserae-device-inkyframe), the Tesserae-maintained fork of Carl Partridge's [partridgeworks/tesserae.inkyframe](https://github.com/partridgeworks/tesserae.inkyframe). Confirmed on a Pico 2 W Frame: pairing, painting (upright, in the Spectra 6 palette), the five buttons, the setup portal and signed over-the-air updates from Settings → Firmware, which need the A/B partition table written once over USB (see the firmware README). A Frame with an original Pico W runs the same firmware without over-the-air updates.
